ask:
Post-cull cleanup batch for claude-settings. This replaces my earlier brief.

My rulings, given Oct 19 in my advisor chat:
- The cull is closed (10:18 am). Additions are allowed again.
- Delete the no-incident exception from building-guard-needs-incident (10:42 am). Lane 4 below.
- #455, #456 and #457 are my own paused map work. Do not touch them, their branches or their checks.

Run four lanes in parallel, each in its own worktree; they touch different files. Merge them as one batch.

Lane 1, janitor sweep fetch fix. First, read only: run the sweep's preview in q_max and report how many worktrees it keeps for each keep reason. Then change the sweep: run git fetch --prune at the start, and drop a remote head the clone lacks instead of keeping every worktree as unreadable. Add a test that goes red on main with an unfetched remote commit and green on the fix.

Lane 2, merged remote branches. Read only: list the remote heads on origin, and which are already in origin/main, by ancestry or by patch (a-branch-is-redundant-by-patch-not-by-ancestry). Leave the map branches (batch-map, map-format-version, map-skill-move) out of the list. Report the counts and the list. Delete nothing; wait for my word. Then propose the merge-step change so each merge deletes the lane branches its batch absorbed.

Lane 3, PR #384, read only. #384 (claude-p) has been a draft since Oct 13. Check the handoffs, plans, debts and notes for why it was kept open, and whether anything ever ran bin/claude-p. Report the reason or 'none found', and whether closing it loses anything. Do not close it.

Lane 4, close the no-incident exception. In CLAUDE.md, rule building-guard-needs-incident, delete this sentence: 'A check that enforces a rule in this file needs no other incident.' Change nothing else in CLAUDE.md. If a decision, lint or test quotes that sentence, update it in the same lane. This only deletes, so it gets one review round.

Report per lane: what changed and what is waiting on me. End with the four size numbers on main after the batch: decision files, debt files without README and notes.md, hooks/*.py lines, CLAUDE.md words.
note: Checked Oct 20 at 84d4076: janitor/sweep.py now runs fetch --prune (records the roots whose fetch failed). Not confirmed: that a test goes red on an unfetched remote commit, and the q_max keep-reason counts the brief asked for (session report not seen in the advisor chat). Lesson, Oct 19: a session cannot see the advisor chat, so a brief that cites an owner ruling must state the ruling itself.
title: Fix the janitor sweep
why: It never fetches, so one unfetched remote commit makes it keep every worktree as unreadable. Fetch first, and skip remote heads the clone lacks.
